Taco Cream Cheese Dip
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, April 13, 2010 - 12:27am

Ingredients




2 pkgs. cream cheese, softened
16 ounces sour cream
1 tablespoon milk
1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
1 pkg. dry taco seasoning
Toppings: Lettuce, grated cheese, 
Preparation

1 Combine first 4 ingredients and blend until smooth. Layer onto a pizza pan. Sprinkle with taco seasoning and top with toppings of your choice. Chill until serving time. Serve with tortilla chips.
